title: At Any Expense
coreMove: Refuse to call a win clean until you have found who pays the hidden bill.
sourcePressure: Warns that visible success becomes morally thin when the human bill is hidden, delayed, or displaced onto less visible people.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Making this anti-performance or ignoring hard tradeoffs instead of exposing displaced cost.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.stakes: the win depends on unpaid prep hours hidden in the kitchen
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she adds prep-hour cards to the profit review before accepting the next wedding
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a stack of prep cards beside a plated tasting spoon

exampleSpecs.audience: product manager shipping a growth feature
exampleSpecs.stakes: growth moves abuse cleanup to moderators offscreen
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he opens the moderator backlog before signing the launch checklist
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a moderation queue beside a launch checklist

exampleSpecs.stakes: savings may displace injury and speed pressure onto workers
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she asks to see the fold-rate injury log before awarding the contract
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a bid sheet beside a linen cart tag

exampleSpecs.stakes: low cost hides chaperone exhaustion and student risk
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the director matches the saved dollars to missed medication checks on the bus
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a tour invoice beside a medication roster

exampleSpecs.stakes: speed gain hides picker strain and spoiled returns
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she predicts the cost per box, then adds the injury log and spoilage bin to the same page
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a thermal label beside a spoilage bin tag

exampleSpecs.stakes: savings came from one person living cold and silent
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the group puts the thermostat log beside each person's room temperature notes
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a thermostat log beside a quilt on a chair

skillTargets: distinguish hard tradeoff from displaced burden

tryThisNowSpec: For one recent win, write the receipt: who got credit, who carried cleanup, and whose cost stayed offscreen.
